description: Agent Commitments: submit the open-commitment ledger an agent works from with the commitments it made: optionally the ledger with its owner and the date it was read; each ledger entry with its id, the id of the commitment it tracks, the commitment as the entry states it, the promisee, its status (open, in progress, blocked, done or cancelled), when it was last updated and, for a cancelled entry, whether the promisee released the agent from it; each commitment made with its id, the commitment, the promisee and whether it is still owed; and optionally how many days an open status may go without an update (14 when left out). The signed report gives the ledger, every entry with its age and its status as current, stale, dropped_silently, released, duplicate, orphaned, contradicts_record or unconfirmed, and every commitment made with its status as on_ledger, missing, closed or unconfirmed, and names a ledger the agent cannot work from: open commitments missing from it and entries cancelled with no release from the promisee; then statuses that disagree with the record, open statuses not updated within the interval, two entries for one commitment and entries tied to no commitment made or no promisee, with the fix for each. This reads the agent’s own ledger: a group’s joint progress against its plan is wever_coordination-progress-check, and whether a delegate owes its principal reports is wever_delegation-reporting-check. Verdict commitment_ledger_unreliable, commitment_tracking_gaps, commitment_tracking_unverified or commitments_tracked. POST /api/commitment-tracking-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.

entries.description: Each entry on the ledger the agent works from.

commitment.description: The commitment as the entry states it.

commitment_id.description: The id of the commitment as made, such as c1.

id.description: The ledger entry id, such as l1.

released.description: For a cancelled entry, the promisee released the agent from it.

status.description: Open, in progress, blocked, done or cancelled.

updated_at.description: When the status was last updated.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

as_of.description: When the ledger was read, as a date.

owner.description: The agent whose ledger it is.

made.description: Each commitment the agent made, to read the ledger against.

id.description: The commitment id, such as c1.

open.description: It is still owed: not delivered and not released by the promisee.

stale_days.description: Days an open status may go without an update; 14 when left out.

title: Commitment tracking check
